document.abstract: A current trend in television show episodic production is the use of electronic camera systems that capture moving images using ‘progressive scanning’ techniques. We at Fox have been investigating progressive scan camera systems over the past few years and beginning two years ago, embarked on a project to develop state of the art electronic camera systems that can be used for television productions that currently use film.
